investigations.scope: Read-only control-path/log/journal/config investigation, no GPU work, no source edits, no tests or process changes. Only this diagnosis record written.

findings.verified: Two separate tool sessions returned exit143 with empty output; owned runner and server later absent. Exit143 is consistent with 128+SIGTERM(15); sender and exact signaled process were not recorded.

Successful fresh1/retry1 and interrupted fresh2/offload diagnostic use exec_command yield_time_ms1000, no explicit tty/login/shell overrides, followed by empty write_stdin polls yield_time_ms60000. Polling is a wait interval, not a configured benchmark deadline.
findings.inference: No evidence supports blaming the shared polling pattern or a fixed 120/180-second timeout: failed run ages differ and unchanged successful runs last longer.

findings.verified: benchmark-bfs.py start_server uses Popen without a new session/process group; finish_server sends SIGINT then after30s SIGTERM and after10s SIGKILL to the owned server process only. This code does not send a termination signal to its own benchmark runner. No summary/result was persisted in interrupted runs.
findings.inference: Abrupt runner termination bypassing finally is consistent with the artifacts. Parent/process-group/session cleanup remains a hypothesis; exact live PGID/cgroup was not retained.

findings.verified: No kill/pkill/killall/os.kill/killpg/terminate or nonempty write_stdin tool action was found in the inspected root/agent tool-call windows18:18:45–18:40:20 UTC.
findings.limitation: This is not a system-wide signal audit and cannot exclude an external sender, execution-manager cleanup or unlogged action.

findings.verified: The inspected user journal has no entries at10:37:20–10:40:40 local; targeted system/kernel journal checks identify no relevant SIGTERM sender, OOM kill or new GPU fault for offload diagnostic. The earlier fresh3 GPU page fault is distinct.
findings.limitation: Linux does not normally journal every kill signal. Absence of a log does not identify/exclude a sender.

findings.verified: RTK1.1.0 global hook configuration invokes rtk hook codex. RTK config limits govern output sizes; no command runtime timeout appears. Its SQLite history has no recorded benchmark command and no hook decision in this run window (latest hook decision16:57:57 UTC).
findings.limitation: No actual rewritten benchmark launch was recorded, so RTK involvement cannot be established from available evidence. Local RTK/Codex process-management source is unavailable; binary behavior not inferred.
